evals.prompt: I have a CSV with patientIndex and model descriptor columns. Help me create a Jinkō vpop safely with the SDK.
evals.expected_output: Uses create_vpop_from_csv or create_vpop_from_dataframe, checks patientIndex and descriptor headers, and requires --apply before upload.

evals.prompt: Create a vpop design from marginal distributions for Dose and k_elim and generate 10 patients from it.
evals.expected_output: Uses create_vpop_design_from_design with unique marginal IDs, checks distrib.json, prints design diagnostics, blocks on diagnostic errors, and only then uses design.generate_vpop().

evals.prompt: Can I edit a generated vpop? I need to change the marginal distribution for k_elim.
evals.expected_output: Explains that generated/uploaded Vpop items are not edited in place; edit the Vpop design and regenerate a new Vpop.

evals.prompt: Apply three marginal edits to vd-123. The second update fails after the first succeeds; tell me exactly what happened and do not claim the design is valid without checking it.
evals.expected_output: Uses sequential descriptor mutators, reports the ID applied before the failure, and returns failure. On a fully applied sequence it always prints fresh post-edit diagnostics and only reports success when there are no errors.

evals.prompt: Create a Vpop design from a marginal list that contains Dose twice with different distributions.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the duplicate Dose marginal ID before creating any project item rather than silently keeping the last distribution.
